name: Guilty Summer Kiss
source:
Guilty Summer Kiss is an addicting dating sim with beautiful characters and twists! You and your friend made a bet: could you win the hearts of the three most unapproachable girls in your school? This seems to be an impossible task, but it's not like you to give up without a fight!

Cute dreamer, lively tomboy and calm smart student. They're so different, but you can always get on the right side of each girl. Show how skilled you're in the art of seduction. Grow closer to each girl and make all three of them fall in love with you. But be very careful and don't say too much - if at least one of the beauties finds out about your womanising nature, you'll lose the bet!
Get on this dangerous romantic path: keep track of your relationship and make sure that your love interests don't know about each other.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/845500/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Guilty Summer Kiss》是一款让人欲罢不能的恋爱模拟游戏，有着漂亮的角色和曲折的情节！你和朋友打了个赌：你能否赢得学校里最难接近的三个女孩的芳心？这看似是不可能完成的任务，但不战而退可不是你的作风！

爱做梦的可爱女孩、活泼的假小子，以及沉稳的优等生。她们性格迥异，但你总能找到讨每个女孩欢心的方法。展现你的撩人本领，逐渐拉近与她们的距离，让三人都爱上你。不过，务必小心，别说漏了嘴——只要其中一位美女发现你花心的本性，这场赌局就算你输！
踏上这条危险的恋爱之路吧：留意各段关系的进展，确保你的恋爱对象们不知道彼此的存在。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/845500/]Steam[/url]]
